newsitem.title: ZAIRE: Zairean rebels looking at Mobutu proposal.
newsitem.headline: Zairean rebels looking at Mobutu proposal.

text.p: Zairean rebel leader Laurent Kabila and his advisers are looking at a proposal put forward by ailing President Mobutu Sese Seko at peace talks on board a South African ship on Sunday, a spokesman for the rebels said.

"Kabila and his team have gone into a closed meeting. We are...examining Mobutu's proposal. Things will become clear in the next 10 minutes," rebel "foreign minister" Bizima Karaha told Reuters by telephone.
He was speaking from off the Congolese coast aboard the South African navy ship the Outeniqua, where Mobutu and Kabila met for more than one hour.
He did not give details of the proposal but he said earlier that Mobutu was proposing to transfer power to an interim third party other than the rebel leader.
He said this was not acceptable to the rebels, who control about three quarters of the country.
Mobutu is also consulting his aides, Karaha added.
